entities.title: zazz scripts
entities.summary: The three crates behind zazz scripts: packaging (the .zazz archive, manifest and script id), engine (the script protocol and SDK) and runner (the WebAssembly host the daemon starts).
entities.purpose: Groups the zazz script crates the daemon builds on; each is its own crate in the Cargo workspace.
boundaries: A grouping folder: it has no code of its own.
runner is a separate program, zazz-script-runner, installed in libexec/zazzle beside the daemon.
